structured_output.what_is_happening: A copycat 'Effective Accelerationism' (e/acc) token. It was created directly on PumpSwap about 12 minutes before detection, with no pump.fun curve. It is one of at least 9 same-name clones launched within roughly 40 minutes. They all appear to be chasing a UsePaid token (CbcyNo...) that routes fees to @beffjezos. This token's description links to that other contract, which suggests this is not the canonical token. Price doubled in 12 minutes on about $2M of volume against a $145k market cap. Liquidity ($207k) is higher than the market cap, which means the dev seeded the pool directly, and the LP is 100% unlocked.

narrative.description: Beff Jezos / e/acc meme tied to a UsePaid creator-fee token for @beffjezos. It's a recognizable crypto-Twitter figure, so the narrative has real pull for the canonical token.
narrative.why_spreading: A known personality appears to be linked to a fee-sharing launch, and a wave of clones is copying it. Traders are spreading their bets across the clones.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond the copied name and description. The description itself points to the canonical contract CbcyNo..., not to this one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo... (canonical UsePaid, $797k mcap, $2.8M h1 volume), 3m7Bhp... ($990k), 7dVWL... ($274k, $5.2M h1 volume), and 6+ other clones.

authenticity.evidence: 534 unique buyers against only 55 unique sellers. GMGN flags 50 bundler wallets holding about 25.8% of top-trader share. A turnover of 9.5x mcap in 12 minutes points to heavy churn and bot activity. There are no paid boosts and no KOL or smart-money wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: Some of the buying is probably real narrative spillover from the canonical token. How much of the volume is wash trading is unclear.

structural_risks: LP is 100% unlocked and a dev-seeded pool of about $207k (larger than mcap) can be pulled at any time
Not canonical: the description links to another contract
More than 9 same-name clones splitting attention
Unknown deploy platform, and the pool was not created through the pump.fun curve

The pool is dev-seeded, the LP is unlocked and the pool holds more than the market cap, which is a classic setup for pulling liquidity. It has already doubled and the 5-minute price is turning down. The chance of another 2x before a rug or a -50% move is low.
